sources.title: PostgreSQL WAL introduction
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SQLite SAVEPOINT：局部失敗與批次回復
related.titleEn: SQLite SAVEPOINT: partial failure and batch rollback
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以 LSN 簡化模型推演三個當機點，判斷頁面更新是否可復原。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use a simplified LSN model to analyze three crash points and recoverability. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 在外層交易中處理三個子批次，讓一個失敗只回復自己的寫入。
related.differenceEn: Process three sub-batches inside an outer transaction and roll back only the failed sub-batch.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 資料頁落盤前，其對應 redo 日誌必須持久化；本課只示範 redo 順序，不實作完整 PostgreSQL recovery。 教學基準：10+5+5 = 20 recovered count；第二檢核：120-100 = 20 modeled LSN gap。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
SAVEPOINT 提供巢狀回復位置；RELEASE 內層並不等於外層交易已永久提交。 教學基準：10+3+2 = 15 rows after accepted sub-batches；第二檢核：10+3+4+2 = 19 rows without rollback。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A page must not become durable before its redo log; this lesson models ordering rather than full PostgreSQL recovery. Teaching baseline: 10+5+5 = 20 recovered count; second check: 120-100 = 20 modeled LSN gap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

SAVEPOINT provides nested rollback positions; releasing an inner savepoint is not a durable outer commit. Teaching baseline: 10+3+2 = 15 rows after accepted sub-batches; second check: 10+3+4+2 = 19 rows without rollback. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 查詢最佳化：選擇性相依與估計誤差
related.titleEn: Query optimization: correlated predicates and estimation error
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以 LSN 簡化模型推演三個當機點，判斷頁面更新是否可復原。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use a simplified LSN model to analyze three crash points and recoverability. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 設計完全相關的城市與郵遞區號，展示獨立性假設如何低估列數。
related.differenceEn: Construct perfectly correlated city/postal attributes to expose independence-estimation errors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

估計 P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B) 需要獨立；資料相關時聯合統計比各欄邊際更重要。 教學基準：10000*0.1*0.1 = 100 independent estimated rows；第二檢核：1000/100 = 10 underestimate factor。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Teaching baseline: 10+5+5 = 20 recovered count; second check: 120-100 = 20 modeled LSN gap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Estimating P(A and B)=P(A)P(B) assumes independence; correlated data needs joint information. Teaching baseline: 10000*0.1*0.1 = 100 independent estimated rows; second check: 1000/100 = 10 underestimate factor. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
